t.zh: 保持与<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>相同的采样位置，改用<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>。先看一行上靠左、靠右两点怎样变化，再把这个做法用于四个角；图外仍取最近边界。
t.en: Keep the same sample positions but use <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>. First compare points near either end of a row, then extend that reasoning to four corners. Outside positions still use the nearest boundary. (<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>)

after.zh: 横向与纵向分别考虑距离，可以在四个邻居之间连续过渡。这减少了阶梯感，却不会补回原图未记录的细节；平滑的结果不等于更多真实信息。
after.en: Considering horizontal and vertical distances separately gives a continuous transition between four neighbours. It reduces stepping without recovering detail absent from the original; a smoother result does not contain more measured information.

brief.zh: [0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的距离加权，写出每个值。
brief.en: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> on each side by distance: write each value.

hint.zh: x = 0.25 离 0 有 0.25，离 1 有 0.75：离得近的那边该占几成？
hint.en: x = 0.25 is 0.25 from 0 and 0.75 from 1: what share should the nearer side take?

why.zh: 这是照抄最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
why.en: That copies the nearest <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

brief.zh: 这张 2 × 2 的图在 x、y 都取 −1/6、0.5、7/6 的 9 个位置取值：写出 3 × 3 的结果。
brief.en: Read this 2 × 2 image at the nine positions where x and y are each −1/6, 0.5 or 7/6: write the 3 × 3 result.

hint.zh: 中间那一行在 y = 0.5，正好在两行中间：先把上下两行各自横着算好，再竖着取中间。
hint.en: The middle row is at y = 0.5, right between the rows: work out the top and bottom rows across first, then take between them.

why.zh: 这是只横着加权、竖直方向照抄最近的一行：中间一行在两行正中，却整个抄了下面一行。竖着也按距离加权，中心是四个邻居的平均 6。
why.en: That weights across only and copies the nearest row: the middle row, right between two, copies the lower. Weighted by distance downwards too, the centre is the average of the four, 6.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

hint.zh: 先找出左上的邻居：坐标向下取整；位置离它多远，就是右边和下边邻居的权重。
hint.en: First find the top-left neighbour: round the coordinates down; how far the position is from it is the weight of the neighbours right and below.
